draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.24, the 66th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 8th of 28 at WR. He went 54th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: KeeSean Johnson. Testing standouts: 10-yard split (96th percentile). College production: 1,292 receiving yards in 2021, 4th of 28 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Green Bay Packers. 53 career games and 11 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 2 in 2022. Weak spots: team target share 1.3% (11th percentile), receiving td 0 (13th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 wide receiver who played: 87 receiving yards against a median of 302, below the norm.
